root.name: Four Knights Game: Scotch Variation
root.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Nc3 Nf6 4. d4

overview: White opens the centre at once. The main line is 4...exd4 5.Nxd4 Bb4 6.Nxc6 bxc6 7.Bd3 d5 8.exd5 cxd5 9.O-O O-O 10.Bg5 c6, an open game in which Black has doubled pawns on the c-file and White has a slight initiative. Black can also pin with 4...Bb4 5.Nd5. White aims for development and pressure; Black for activity and a pawn centre.

white_ideas.idea: Take the centre with d4, then Nxc6 and Bd3, using lead in development.
Bg5 to pin and develop the rooks to the e-file.

black_ideas.idea: Pin with ...Bb4 and strike back with ...d5.
Accept doubled c-pawns for central control and the b-file.

typical_structures.structure: Open centre with Black doubled pawns on c-file after Nxc6 bxc6.

character.notes: Open but fairly symmetrical, tactics exist but nothing forced; Belgrade Gambit is a sideline.

gambit.notes: Main lines have no gambit; Belgrade and Oxford gambits are sidelines.

structure.notes: Centre opens quickly after exd4 and ...d5.

gambit.reason: Main lines have no material imbalance.

plans.reason: White uses faster development against Black's doubled c-pawns.
